args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
- Changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

transcript.reasoning_content:
Note: 2.675 quantized to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_EVEN — Decimal("2.675") is exactly 2.675, half-even gives 2.68 (since 2.67 is odd digit 7, 2.68 is even digit 8 → picks even: 2.68). And 2.665 → half-even picks 2.66 (6 even vs 7 odd). Yes, half-even works.

Fix: change ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
